name: Québec
standard: SGQRI 008 3.0 — WCAG 2.1 AA plus selected WCAG 2.2 criteria (A: 3.2.6, 3.3.7; AA: 2.4.11, 2.5.7, 2.5.8, 3.3.8; AAA: 2.4.13)

laws.cite: Loi sur la gouvernance et la gestion des ressources informationnelles des organismes publics et des entreprises du gouvernement (RLRQ c. G-1.03), art. 2
laws.summary: Defines the public bodies the standard applies to.

laws.cite: Loi assurant l'exercice des droits des personnes handicapées
laws.summary: Underlying disability-rights basis cited by the standard.

policy_docs.title: Standard sur l'accessibilité des sites Web (SGQRI 008 3.0)

applies_to: Public bodies under art. 2 of Loi G-1.03 (ministries and agencies, and others listed).

deadlines.what: SGQRI 008 3.0 in force; content online before this date remains under 2.0

exceptions: Existing content only on significant modification
Content online before 2024-04-29 governed by SGQRI 008 2.0
requires: All new web content, including documents, multimedia and downloadable files, meets SGQRI 008 3.0 from design
mobile: implied — covers web content on desktops, laptops, tablets and mobile devices, but not native mobile apps.
enforcement: Government standard administered by the Ministère de la Cybersécurité et du Numérique; no penalty regime found.
notes: The brief named SGQRI 008-2.0, but 3.0 superseded it on 2024-04-29. The LégisQuébec URLs follow the standard pattern and were not opened.
